source_policy: Original generated art. PDF reference illustrations are not game assets.

prompts.tools: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL transparent UI tool sprite atlas for a modern premium 2D cartoon salon makeover game, exactly THREE equal columns on one row, ideally 1536x512. Three separate clearly recognizable tool clusters with generous transparent padding, polished hand-painted clean linework, dimensional soft shading and metallic highlights. Left cell: professional silver hair-cutting scissors with small warm-brass finger rings and one deep-teal comb, diagonally arranged. Middle cell: coral dye bowl holding warm chestnut tint and a deep-teal handled tint brush. Right cell: stylish deep-teal compact hair dryer with warm-brass details and coral nozzle, alongside a simple round hair brush. No hands or characters. Same illustration style and refined proportions across all three, detailed yet legible at small size. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no labels or lettering, no rectangular backgrounds, no grid, no watermark, no pixel art. Each cluster entirely within its own equal cell.
prompts.salon: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 2D game salon environment, widescreen 1920x1080 or larger 16:9. Create a completely original beautifully illustrated modern hair salon for a polished casual makeover game. No characters, no text, no UI, no logos. Soft warm ivory plaster, sage teal cabinets, polished brass details, coral upholstered styling chairs, tall rounded mirrors with soft indirect light, richly detailed shelves of beauty products, broad windows with soft afternoon light, leafy plants, light terrazzo floor. Orthographic-ish straight-on room view, inviting and elegant, hand painted modern cartoon illustration with clean contours, dimensional soft shading and beautiful material details, NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D render. Keep a clear central floor area for full-body character sprites and room for UI overlays at top/right; furnishings predominantly along rear wall and outer sides. Sharp professional quality consistent palette ivory, dark teal, terracotta, honey brass.
prompts.sofia: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent game character sprite atlas, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, equal cells, ideally 1536x2048 total. Six FULL BODY sprites of ONE completely original adult character Sofia, a kind slightly nervous first-time salon client preparing for a job interview. Identity in every cell: warm medium golden-brown skin, distinctive softly squared face, expressive hazel almond eyes, subtle freckles across cheeks, straight softly rounded nose, small natural full lips, thick dark brown side-parted hair, believable young adult proportions (about 6.5 heads tall), elegant hands. Premium modern 2D cartoon game illustration, polished clean linework, detailed hair highlights and soft dimensional shading, no pixel art, no resemblance to existing famous characters. Cell order left to right: TOP LEFT before makeover: slightly unstyled long dark-brown hair reaching lower back, muted plum casual blouse and olive trousers, nervous gentle closed-mouth expression. TOP MIDDLE professional result: SAME LONG dark-brown hair neatly straight reaching lower back, tailored deep teal blazer, ivory blouse and dark trousers, confident friendly smile. TOP RIGHT alternate professional result: SAME LONG hair in warm chestnut soft waves reaching lower back, SAME teal blazer/ivory blouse/dark trousers, friendly smile. BOTTOM LEFT incorrect bold option for gameplay: SAME person with short copper-red bob, SAME casual outfit, doubtful expression. BOTTOM MIDDLE same as top left before, but blinking eyes fully closed and mouth slightly open speaking. BOTTOM RIGHT same as top middle long dark hair professional outfit, eyes closed in joyful smile celebration. Same front-facing three-quarter pose, identical head/body proportions and feet baseline in each equally sized cell, no overlap, lots of transparent padding between cells. Transparent RGBA background in every cell, no background rectangles, NO labels or lettering, NO grid lines. Never shorten the hair in either professional success variant.
